notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Guide to secrets in CI/CD: tool overview (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), Vault setup and GitHub/GitLab integrations, AWS Secrets Manager with GitHub Actions and Terraform, GitHub/GitLab secrets, a rotation Lambda, External Secrets Operator and TruffleHog secret scanning.

Medium: following it has the agent run a Vault dev server with the default `root` token (SKILL.md:58-62, local dev only), write secrets with `vault kv put` and `aws secretsmanager create-secret` (SKILL.md:68, 122-124), and run a pinned TruffleHog container in a pre-commit hook (SKILL.md:323-325). Acceptable because the subject is managing the user's own secrets, values are placeholders, CI samples use platform secret references with masking (SKILL.md:143), and the skill advises never printing secrets.

Caveat: the GitLab project-variables example echoes `$API_KEY` and `$DATABASE_URL` to job logs (SKILL.md:204-205), contradicting the skill's own advice; users should not copy it unless the variables are masked. Passing `--secret-string` on the command line leaves the value in shell history. Related skills are named by backtick name only (SKILL.md:347-349); optional.
